drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A high-gain lead guitar performs rapid alternate picking and pinch harmonics. The bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. The drum kit features a prominent double-kick pedal pattern, a crisp snare, and frequent crash cymbal accents. 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature. E Minor.
